blocks.text: Mastering Word for data entry clerks on Mac

Data entry is about rhythm. You need to maintain a high keystroke rate while ensuring accuracy. Word for Mac often gets in the way with its complex interface. The key is to stop using the mouse for every minor change. Use ⌘ + S to save often. Use ⌘ + Z to undo mistakes instantly. If you find yourself clicking through menus, stop. Learn the keyboard equivalent instead.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for your daily workflow

items: Move by word: ⌥ + Left or Right Arrow
Select by word: ⌥ + ⇧ + Left or Right Arrow
Go to start of line: ⌘ + Left Arrow
Go to end of line: ⌘ + Right Arrow

blocks.text: The last one, paste without formatting, is a lifesaver. It strips away the weird fonts and colors that come from web pages or PDFs. You get clean text that matches your document style.
How to handle repetitive document formatting

You likely handle the same document types every day. Do not format them from scratch. Create a template. Go to File > Save as Template. This keeps your margins, fonts, and headers consistent. If you need to add page numbers, do not type them manually. Use the Insert > Page Numbers menu. It handles the logic for you.

Word 16.114.1 can crash or freeze. If it happens, do not panic. First, force quit by pressing ⌥ + ⌘ + Esc. Select Microsoft Word and click Force Quit. If it keeps happening, check your Mac for updates. Microsoft supports the three most recent versions of macOS. If you are on an older system, you are missing out on fixes.
Using Lazur to speed up your day

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It is there when you get stuck in a deep menu. Hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask where a feature is. Lazur will draw a circle around it. You do not need to hunt for the button. It works in any app, but it is great for the complex ribbons in Word.

faq.question: Is there a better way to type text in Word?
faq.answer: Hold the fn key to dictate text. It is faster than typing for long passages and helps reduce strain on your wrists.

faq.question: Why is Word slow on my Mac?
faq.answer: It might be corrupted preferences or a lack of system permissions. Try running First Aid in Disk Utility to see if your drive has issues.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my forms?
faq.answer: Lazur cannot click buttons or fill forms for you. It can guide you to the right place or dictate information you provide.
